title: Add accepted alpha bundle fixture
summary: Alpha release evidence validation should prove the happy path too: a clean, ready, all-passed accepted bundle must validate without local environment overrides.
expectedFailureModes: The validator only proves rejection paths and misses a broken accepted-bundle path.

humanEscalation: Published release schema changes still require human approval once real public bundles exist.
nextAction: Add a synthetic accepted bundle fixture to validate-alpha-release-evidence, document the positive acceptance coverage, and keep the fixture self-cleaning.
